m.s: Heat the oven to 210°C. Cut {pumpkin} into 2cm cubes, toss with oil, {cumin} and salt on a lined tray, and roast for 30 minutes until caramelised at the edges.
Mix {harissa} with a squeeze of {lemon} and a little oil. Coat {chk_breast} and leave for 15 minutes.
Rinse {quinoa} well in a sieve. Simmer in a saucepan with twice its volume of water for 12 minutes until the little tails pop out. Drain any leftover water and fluff with a fork.

Heat a grill pan or frying pan over medium heat with a drizzle of oil. Cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes a side until cooked through (75°C in the thickest part). Harissa catches, so turn the heat down if it's charring too fast. Rest, then slice.
Toss the warm quinoa with {spinach}, the pumpkin, thinly sliced {red_onion}, the rest of the lemon juice and a drizzle of oil. Season to taste.
Top with the chicken and crumbled {fetta}. Mix {yoghurt} with chopped {mint} and spoon it over.

l: Built for lunch. Good warm or cold, yoghurt on the side. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the harissa label.
